title: Nucleus Pipelines Status
description: Trixie packages -> container-forge base images -> ansible-forge staging, sync, builds and scans. Fed by emit_event.sh and the scan/build metric scripts via node_exporter's textfile collector.

panels.title: Current date / time
panels.description: Time of the last dashboard refresh (refreshes every minute).

options.content:
**1. Trixie** builds nginx / openssl packages (weekly)  →  **2. container-forge** builds the base images (daily 0500)  →  **3. ansible-forge** stages binaries (weekly), syncs base images (0600), builds the stacks and scans every image.

🟢 ok    🔴 failed    🟡 not reporting yet

panels.title: Pipeline hosts
panels.description: Exporter reachable? A red host means the metrics beside it may be stale. Filter is HOST_REGEX at the top of build_dashboard.py.

panels.title: TRIXIE · package builds (weekly)
panels.description: Result of the last weekly nginx / openssl package job.

targets.expr: pipeline_last_status{type="repo"} or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "nginx", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "openssl", "", "")

panels.title: TRIXIE · package versions
panels.description: 'upstream' = newest version seen on the last weekly run; 'built' = the last package actually built. 'Date' is when that version was recorded by the pipeline (no upstream release date is collected).

panels.title: CONTAINER-FORGE · base image builds (daily 0500)
panels.description: Result of the last build of each base image.

targets.expr: pipeline_last_status{type="build",target!~"debian13-node20"} or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "debian13-base", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "debian13-go", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "debian13-node22", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "debian13-node24", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "debian13-postgres18", "", "")

panels.title: CONTAINER-FORGE · digest of each base image built
panels.description: The digest the 0500 build produced. ansible-forge's sync should report the same one.

panels.title: ANSIBLE-FORGE · staged binaries (weekly)
panels.description: Result of the last staging run for each binary.

targets.expr: pipeline_last_status{type="stage"} or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "grafana", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "idrac", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "postgres", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "prometheus", "", "")

panels.title: ANSIBLE-FORGE · base image syncs (daily 0600)
panels.description: Result of the last sync/load of each base image. A 'setup' tile (GPG key / quarter step) appears only if that step fails.

targets.expr: pipeline_last_status{type="sync",target!="setup",target!~"debian13-node20"} or (pipeline_last_status{type="sync",target="setup"} == 0) or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "debian13-base", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "debian13-go", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "debian13-node22", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "debian13-node24", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "debian13-postgres18", "", "")

panels.title: ANSIBLE-FORGE · stack builds
panels.description: Result of the last Guacamole / Grafana build.

targets.expr: pipeline_last_status{type="stack"} or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "guacamole", "", "") or on(target) label_replace(vector(-1), "target", "grafana", "", "")

panels.title: ANSIBLE-FORGE · image scans · Grafana stack
panels.description: Result of the last scan of each Grafana-stack image (Grafana, Prometheus, iDRAC, nginx; ccop and nucleus).

panels.title: ANSIBLE-FORGE · image scans · Guacamole stack
panels.description: Result of the last scan of each Guacamole-stack image (Guacamole, guacd, Postgres, nginx; ccop and nucleus).

panels.title: ANSIBLE-FORGE · image scans · base images and others
panels.description: Container-forge base images, plus any scanned image that matches neither stack row.

panels.title: VULNERABILITIES by image · ccop (latest scan)
panels.description: Findings from each image's most recent scan. One row per image; images are never added together.

panels.title: VULNERABILITIES by image · nucleus (latest scan)
panels.description: Findings from each image's most recent scan. One row per image; images are never added together.

panels.title: VULNERABILITIES by image · container-forge base images (latest scan)
panels.description: Findings from each image's most recent scan. One row per image; images are never added together.

panels.title: TOP 10 vulnerabilities · ccop
panels.description: Worst findings across this pipeline's images, ranked by severity then CVSS. 'Package' says what it pertains to; 'Images' is how many images carry it.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (cve, package, severity, cvss, fix_state) (image_top_vuln{image=~"ccop/.+",image!~".*(debian13-node20)"}))

count by (cve, package, severity, cvss, fix_state) (image_top_vuln{image=~"ccop/.+",image!~".*(debian13-node20)"}) and on(cve, package, severity, cvss, fix_state) topk(10, max by (cve, package, severity, cvss, fix_state) (image_top_vuln{image=~"ccop/.+",image!~".*(debian13-node20)"}))

panels.title: TOP 10 vulnerabilities · nucleus
panels.description: Worst findings across this pipeline's images, ranked by severity then CVSS. 'Package' says what it pertains to; 'Images' is how many images carry it.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (cve, package, severity, cvss, fix_state) (image_top_vuln{image=~"nucleus/.+",image!~".*(debian13-node20)"}))

count by (cve, package, severity, cvss, fix_state) (image_top_vuln{image=~"nucleus/.+",image!~".*(debian13-node20)"}) and on(cve, package, severity, cvss, fix_state) topk(10, max by (cve, package, severity, cvss, fix_state) (image_top_vuln{image=~"nucleus/.+",image!~".*(debian13-node20)"}))

panels.title: JOB FRESHNESS · when did each job last run?
panels.description: Last run / last success are 'how long ago'. 'Due every' is how often the job should run (on demand = no schedule). 'Overdue by' stays 0 until a scheduled job misses its slot.
